name: The Elevator
source: The Elevator takes place in the not-too-distant future and the story centers on a jaded, middle-aged detective. Every morning, he rides a rickety old elevator up to his office on the top floor of a run-down building. For the last couple of months, he has met a young woman every day in this elevator. She always gets off a few floors before him. Sometimes they talk, sometimes they spend the entire elevator ride in complete silence–but how will the relationship between these two people change?
translation: 《电梯》的故事发生在不远的未来，围绕着一位心灰意冷的中年侦探展开。每天早晨，他乘坐一架摇摇欲坠的旧电梯前往破旧大楼顶层的办公室。在过去的几个月里，他每天都在这架电梯里遇到一位年轻女性。她总是在他之前几层下电梯。有时他们会聊天，有时他们整段电梯之旅都在完全的沉默中度过——但这两人的关系将如何改变？
